tasks.label: web: ensure dev dist
tasks.detail: main.go embeds web/dist via go:embed; create a placeholder web/dist/index.html when missing so the backend compiles even without a frontend build.

windows.command: if not exist "${workspaceFolder}\web\dist" (mkdir "${workspaceFolder}\web\dist" & echo ^<html^>^<body^>use frontend dev server^</body^>^</html^> > "${workspaceFolder}\web\dist\index.html")

tasks.label: web: dev server
tasks.detail: Start the frontend dev server (Rsbuild) with /api, /mj, /pg proxied to the backend. Needs `bun` on PATH.

windows.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}\web && bun install && bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
